Value does not conform to Shape [ sh:class nltl:plating ; sh:property [ sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:minCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:node [ sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ; sh:property [ sh:datatype xsd:decimal ; sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:minCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:path qudt:numericValue ], [ sh:hasValue unit:M ; sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:minCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:path qudt:unit ] ] ; sh:path nltl:thickness ], [ sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:minCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:node [ sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ; sh:property [ sh:datatype xsd:decimal ; sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:minCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:path qudt:numericValue ], [ sh:hasValue unit:MilliM ; sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:minCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:path qudt:unit ] ] ; sh:path nltl:corrosionAbrasionAllowance ], [ sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:minCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:node [ sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ; sh:property [ sh:datatype xsd:decimal ; sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:minCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:path qudt:numericValue ], [ sh:hasValue unit:MilliM ; sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:minCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:path qudt:unit ] ] ; sh:path nltl:iceLoadRequiredNetPlateThickness ] ; sh:sparql [ sh:message Literal("The shell plating thickness must equal the ice-load net plate thickness plus the corrosion and abrasion allowance, with the result expressed in metres.") ; sh:select Literal("
                    PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
                    PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
                    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

                    SELECT $this
                    WHERE {
                        $this nltl:iceLoadRequiredNetPlateThickness ?netQuantity ;
                              nltl:corrosionAbrasionAllowance ?allowanceQuantity ;
                              nltl:thickness ?thicknessQuantity .

                        ?netQuantity qudt:numericValue ?net .
                        ?allowanceQuantity qudt:numericValue ?allowance .
                        ?thicknessQuantity qudt:numericValue ?actual .

                        BIND((?net + ?allowance) / 1000 AS ?expected)
                        BIND(
                            IF(
                                ABS(?expected) > 0.000001,
                                ABS(?expected) * 0.000001,
                                0.000001
                            ) AS ?tolerance
                        )

                        FILTER(ABS(?actual - ?expected) > ?tolerance)
                    }
                ") ] ]. See details for more information.
The shell plating thickness must equal the ice-load net plate thickness plus the corrosion and abrasion allowance, with the result expressed in metres.
